codes.name: error_code_unspecified
codes.meaning: No error code was supplied.

codes.name: invalid_argument
codes.meaning: The request is malformed or violates a wire constraint.

codes.name: unauthorized
codes.meaning: The caller is not authenticated; refresh pairing or credentials.

codes.name: forbidden
codes.meaning: The caller is authenticated but not authorized; refresh pairing or credentials.

codes.name: not_found
codes.meaning: The named request, session, or object does not exist.

codes.name: conflict
codes.meaning: The request conflicts with current state; re-read state before retrying.

codes.name: expired
codes.meaning: The request expired before it completed; submit a new request.

codes.name: unsupported_capability
codes.meaning: The peer does not support the required capability; upgrade the relevant side.

codes.name: protocol_version_incompatible
codes.meaning: The peers cannot agree on one protocol version; upgrade the side named in the message.

codes.name: payload_digest_mismatch
codes.meaning: The same command id was sent with a different payload; re-read state and use a new command.

codes.name: approval_expired
codes.meaning: The approval expired; request a fresh approval list.

codes.name: approval_version_mismatch
codes.meaning: The approval version is stale; request a fresh approval list.

codes.name: approval_already_resolved
codes.meaning: The approval was resolved elsewhere; refresh the list.

codes.name: approval_unavailable
codes.meaning: The approval cannot be resolved right now; retry later.

codes.name: snapshot_required
codes.meaning: The cursor can no longer continue; resynchronize from a snapshot.

codes.name: revocations_pending
codes.meaning: The Host has not replayed pending revocations yet; retry after replay.

codes.name: rate_limited
codes.meaning: A rate or concurrency limit was reached; retry after the hint.

codes.name: internal
codes.meaning: An unexpected local failure occurred; retry once, then collect diagnostics.

codes.name: unavailable
codes.meaning: The service is temporarily unreachable; retry with backoff.

codes.name: payload_too_large
codes.meaning: The logical message exceeds the transfer budget; reduce the payload.

codes.name: pairing_fenced
codes.meaning: The unfinished pairing intent can no longer commit; start a new confirmed invitation.

codes.name: pairing_committed_unavailable
codes.meaning: The FINISH committed but its grant is gone; review evidence and pair again.

codes.name: pairing_committed_unconfirmed
codes.meaning: The FINISH committed but Host confirmation is unavailable; review evidence before pairing again.

codes.name: channel_replaced
codes.meaning: The Host replaced the channel that owned the observation; establish a new channel and retry.
